name: The Lobber
description: Adds the Lobber: a curious little goblin that arrives on the first night, plays devious pranks, and can be befriended by feeding/petting it to build Trust. Trust buys you a grace period once it matures over days into an obsessive, malicious tormentor - knocking on doors, shattering windows, staring through them as you sleep, burning your base, and hurling blocks at anyone who dares look its way. Includes underground lore shrines, a trust info screen (press R near a trusted Lobber), and /lobber test commands.
